unit: D154 public eager extreme-row DTO constructors

scope.boundary: run the new external non-friend consumer suite (nextorm.mariadb.tests full project), the affected extreme-row core/provider regression classes, the PostgreSQL+ClickHouse container integration extreme-row classes (DOCKER_HOST=unix:///mnt/wsl/podman-sockets/podman-machine-default/podman-user.sock, providers must not be skipped), and the core+mariadb coverage sweep
scope.rationale: the change publishes three existing eager DTO constructors, adds construction-time validation and an internal trusted construction marker in nextorm.core, and adds an external (no InternalsVisibleTo) contract suite; the affected behavior is construction/validation/laziness and the existing native extreme-row SQL generation, covered by the new external suite plus the affected core/postgres/clickhouse regression classes and the PG/CH container integration classes
